fields.description: Purpose of this shot independently within the final video.
fields.label: Shot Purpose

fields.description:
Shot framing, camera movement, lens perspective, focus behavior and composition instructions.
Define where/how the camera sees the world
fields.label: Camera Direction

fields.description: Defines the primary subject and identity properties that must be preserved within this shot.
fields.label: Subject Identity

fields.description: Describes what happens during the shot, including state changes and interactions.
fields.label: Action / Plot

fields.description: Defines the physical setting, background, lighting environment and scene context.
fields.label: Environment

fields.description: Defines important relative positions, orientation, depth and spatial relationships between subjects and scene elements. Define where objects exist RELATIVE to each other
fields.label: Spatial Composition

fields.description: What must be true at the BEGINNING of the shot.
fields.label: Opening State

fields.description: Important state that must be true at the END of this shot and may carry into the NEXT shot.
fields.label: Ending State

fields.description: Shot-specific identity or state properties that must remain consistent with ADJACIENT SHOTS, NOT the Whole video.
fields.label: Continuity Requirements

fields.description: Describes the desired sound, ambience, dialogue, music characteristics, or sound effects for this shot. This is TEXTUAL INTENT, not an attached audio file.
fields.label: Audio Direction
